description: Tier-to-model-profile mapping for BugWolf's advisory model router (U5 / orchestrator plan lever P1). model_preference and fallback_preference are stable identifier strings the harness resolves to concrete models; candidates are advisory family-level suggestions, never requirements. The router never gates execution: any unavailable tier degrades per fallback_preference, and a missing or malformed manifest silently falls back to the built-in defaults in tools/core/model_router.py.

deterministic.notes: Executed by BugWolf's deterministic core (wordlists, payload rendering, artifact verification, fingerprint parsing, plan generation); no model call is warranted.

local_slm.notes: Bounded probing/fuzzing decisions where a small fast model suffices; family-level names only -- the harness pins exact versions and checks health at dispatch time. Degrades to the deterministic core when no local model is available.

frontier.notes: Open-ended reasoning (chain synthesis, adversarial refutation, exploit construction, novel hypotheses); degrades to local_slm when a frontier model is unavailable.

provenance.baseline: hardcoded defaults in tools/core/model_router.py at v1.2.11 (preference strings preserved byte-for-byte)
provenance.review: operator-overridable; the harness resolves preference strings to concrete endpoints; loader exposes a content digest via tools.core.model_router.config_status()
